name: vault-mcp
summary: Give an app that speaks MCP the gt vault: gt's own vault server over stdio, vault writes through the write queue

scripts_dir.prompt: The folder holding gt_vault_mcp.py (left out: the newest installed gt is used)

connect.description: The gt vault for an MCP app: read and search, and writes by the write queue (stdio)

notes: This runs gt's own vault server on this machine; it needs no key. Whoever can call it can read the whole vault, so register it only for an app you trust with that.
Turn the tools on first: `gt_settings.py set vault_mcp on`. With the setting off the server lists no vault tool and the smoke test fails.

A vault write goes to gt's write queue, never straight to a file; the broker applies, holds or escalates it. vault_queue_write is write-tier: LOTR tiers apply per tool, and the queue itself refuses owner-only files and escalates destructive writes.
disk_write asks for the owner's presence on every call, and disk_read and net_fetch withhold credential-shaped text.
